source_caption:
🎬 The Banker (2020)

The Banker tells the inspiring story of Bernard Garrett and Joe Morris, two ambitious African American entrepreneurs who challenge racial discrimination in the American banking and real estate industries during the 1950s and 1960s. Determined to build wealth and create opportunities for Black communities, the businessmen develop an unconventional strategy by hiring a white man, Matt Steiner, to serve as the public face of their growing business empire. While Bernard and Joe secretly manage operations behind the scenes, their success attracts attention and creates increasingly dangerous challenges. Inspired by true events, the film combines powerful performances, business drama, and emotional storytelling while exploring ambition, equality, entrepreneurship, and the fight against systemic discrimination.

🎭 Genre: Biography • Drama • History • Business

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 2h • PG-13

🎥 Director: George Nolfi

🏆 Recognition: Starring Anthony Mackie, Samuel L. Jackson, Nicholas Hoult, and Nia Long, the film received praise for its performances and portrayal of Black entrepreneurship during the civil rights era.

📺 Where to Watch: Apple TV+ (Apple TV). Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: The Banker is a 2020 American period drama film directed, co-written and produced by George Nolfi. The film stars Anthony Mackie, Nicholas Hoult, Nia Long, Jessie T. Usher and Samuel L. Jackson. The story follows Joe Morris (Jackson) and Bernard Garrett (Mackie), two of the first African-American bankers in the United States. The film began a limited theatrical on March 6, 2020, before streaming on Apple TV+ on March 20. It received generally positive reviews from critics.
